motivation: Deploy an explicitly requested immutable Chuggy revision through chuggy-fabric.
acceptanceCriteria: The requested source ref resolves to the immutable Chuggy commit inspected by work and evaluation.
Finalization publishes API and Web UI build requests for that same commit to chuggy-fabric.
constraints: Do not modify Chuggy or chuggy-fabric during work or evaluation; finalization alone publishes the generated build requests.

instructions: Inspect the pinned Chuggy revision and verify that it is the revision the ticket intends to deploy; do not author a source change.
Read .chug/tasks/review-change.md and verify the pinned revision and full-deploy intent without authoring changes.
Run .chug/tasks/ci.sh against the pinned revision and pass only when it exits cleanly; exit 2 is not a pass.
